meta.title: The Burnt Curry
meta.textType: story: a cooking class where a pan goes wrong

paragraphs: On Wednesday, April seventh, the second morning of the cooking course began. Chef Lucy showed the class a new dish, a vegetable curry. "First, heat a little oil in the pan," she said. "Then add the garlic and the curry paste." "Keep the heat low, because the paste may burn." Lily and Mia cooked at one cooker, and May stirred a pot at the next one. Lily told Mia a joke from Leo about a chili that wanted to be a banana. Mia laughed so much that she held the table. Lily forgot the pan. The paste turned black, and a thin gray line of smoke rose from the pan. Chef Lucy looked up and began to walk across the room.

Quickly, Lily put a dish towel over the pan. "Are you all right?" asked Mia quietly. "I'm fine," said Lily in a small voice. Her ears turned red, and the whole kitchen smelled burnt. Mia said nothing, but she moved her stool closer. Chef Lucy stopped at their cooker. "Does anybody need help?" she asked. She lifted the towel and looked at the black paste. "Every cook burns the paste once," Chef Lucy told Lily. "I burned mine many times," she added. "Don't worry, Lily." "Take a clean pan, and this time watch the heat." Lily nodded and started again, and she did not look away from the pan.

At eleven o'clock, the three girls sat at a long table. In front of each girl was a bowl of orange curry and white rice. Steam rose from the bowls. A small card on the table said, "Day Two: Vegetable Curry." Chef Lucy stood at the end of the table and nodded. The curry smelled of garlic and chili, and it had no smoke in it. Lily added a little salt, and May added a little pepper. "We made it ourselves," said May.

Lily ate slowly, and then she looked at Mia. "I burned the first pan," she said. "I know," said Mia. "I smelled it before Chef Lucy did." "Why did you tell nobody?" asked Lily. "You were very quiet," said Mia, "so I moved my stool." Lily smiled at her bowl.

Chef Lucy sat down next to the girls. "Friday is the last morning of the course," she told them. "We will cook a sweet dish," she added. "What if I burn it again?" asked Lily. "Then you might start again," said May. "I may sit next to you," said Mia.
text.summary: On the second morning of the cooking course, Lily forgets her pan, and the curry paste burns. She hides it under a towel and says that she is fine. Mia moves her stool closer, and Chef Lucy tells Lily that every cook burns the paste once.
